title: North Korea launches ballistic missile that falls outside Japanese EEZ
summary: The missile traveled 680 km and fell into the Sea of Japan without causing damage, while Pyongyang rejects dialogue with Seoul.

title: Police search Toyama city hall over alleged population inflation in census
summary: The prefecture investigates whether 2,000 fictitious residents were added in the national census, with the transfer of the responsible official as an initial measure.

title: G7 agrees to release 100 million barrels of oil reserves to contain diesel prices
summary: The measure, driven by the U.S., aims to curb the surge in diesel prices ahead of the midterm elections.

title: Three regional banks in northeastern Japan negotiate merger to create largest financial group in the region
summary: The integration of the three banks seeks to ensure their survival amid population decline, though it faces governance and competition challenges.

title: Woman found dead in Naha hotel; police investigate departure of her companion
summary: The body was discovered after an emergency call and the man accompanying her left the scene, being treated as a possible criminal case.

title: Government proposes four prefectures as candidates for 'sub-capital' to decentralize Tokyo functions
summary: Hokkaido, Aichi, Osaka, and Fukuoka meet preliminary criteria to host backup functions in case of a major disaster.

title: Ohtani arrives in good form for divisional series against Braves, his 'nemesis' this season
summary: The Dodgers face Atlanta starting October 3 with the Japanese player recovered from injury and eager to reverse the 1-5 regular-season record.

title: Trump pressures Europe to lower diesel price ahead of midterm elections
summary: The administration threatens trade measures if the EU does not increase supply, while Japan opts for its domestic refining.

title: Dow Jones rises 250 points after weaker-than-expected jobs report fuels hopes of pause in rate hikes
summary: Job creation below forecasts boosts the stock market and sends Nvidia to record highs.

title: Virtual taekwondo debuts at Asian Games without weight, age, or gender categories
summary: The discipline, similar to a fighting video game, allows women to compete against men and has awarded the first medals in this modality.
